name: vwap_pivot_rejection_5s
author: adapted from aggregated_from_x_indian_traders
thesis: Exploiting rejection/pullback at VWAP + pivot zone confluence due to institutional benchmark execution. Inefficiency from retail ignoring multi-confirmation. Survives because zone width filter + index direction required; manual traders can't execute at scale.
mechanism: VWAP is the institutional execution benchmark. When spot deviates significantly from session VWAP, algorithmic execution engines increase order flow to mean-revert their fills toward VWAP. This creates measurable gravitational pull, especially during lower-volume mid-session periods when fewer competing flows are present.

conditions: price above zone AND rejection == True
price below zone AND rejection == True

weaknesses: Regime dependency: fails when zone is wide (>0.2%)
Liquidity constraints: pivot levels crowded on expiry
Crowding: heavily shared on X by multiple educators
prior_art: VWAP + Pivot combo (popularized by @learntotrade365 on X)
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; apply to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index instead of FnO universe; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
